intro: Ancestral voices, field recordings and electronic bass.
healing_text: There is a quieter side of NAOBA: music for rest and inner listening. These meditations weave the deepest resonances of nature, rivers, whales, rainforest dawns, into slow ambient soundscapes. Each frequency and texture is chosen through research in psychoacoustics, how body and brain respond to sound, and bioacoustics, the voices of living ecosystems. Press play, close your eyes, and let the Earth tune you back.
